faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the AIIMS Delhi Project Technical Support II recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the AIIMS Delhi Project Technical Support II posts is 07 September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Project Technical Support II post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies for the Project Technical Support II position announced by AIIMS Delhi.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for Project Technical Support II?
faq.answer: Candidates need to have completed 12th in Science with a Diploma (MLT/DMLT/Engineering or equivalent) and 5 years of experience, or a 3-year Graduate degree in a relevant field with 2 years of experience.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Project Technical Support II post is 30 years, with age relaxation applicable as per ICMR guidelines.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Project Technical Support II position?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a salary ranging from Rs. 20,000 to Rs. 26,000 per month, which includes a 30% HRA.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Interested candidates can apply for this recruitment by sending their applications via Email.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for AIIMS Delhi Project Technical Support II recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q8. What are the selection stages for the Project Technical Support II role?
faq.answer: The selection process involves Shortlisting of applications, followed by an Interview, and Document Verification.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for the Project Technical Support II posts?
faq.answer: The recruitment for the Project Technical Support II posts is on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be downloaded from the Important Links section of this article.
